model.name: Lobby name from profile, not random
model.description: The lobby 'Your Name' shows the PROFILE name (Marcel Donges), not a random 'User NNN'. THE BUG: RoomBrowser.ts:29 computes memberName SYNCHRONOUSLY before the profile has loaded (an async race) - so profile?.name is null, the random fallback fires, and a different name shows every reload. FIX: use the profile name once it is LOADED (await the profile / re-render on profile-load); the random 'User NNN' is used ONLY as a TRUE last resort (no profile at all). The profile token/uuid is stable (05e58f81) - only the displayed NAME regresses.

model.crossRefNote: Profile-name resolution ties the contact-identity family (R21.1 vCard profile, R25.3 vCard onboarding). Bug is an async-race on profile-load (sync-before-loaded), not an identity-token issue (token 05e58f81 stable).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The lobby 'Your Name' shows the PROFILE name (Marcel Donges), NOT a random 'User NNN'.
THE BUG: RoomBrowser.ts:29 computes memberName SYNC before the profile loads (async race) -> profile?.name null -> random fallback -> a different name every reload.
Fix = use the profile name once LOADED (await profile / re-render on profile-load); random 'User NNN' only as a TRUE last resort (no profile at all).
The profile token/uuid is stable (05e58f81) - only the displayed NAME regresses; the fix must not change the stable identity token, only the name resolution.
